GOAL: establish what repository evidence this session can actually read before proposing an idea.
READ: attempted read of the round workspace and of /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research, plus grep for issue126 and for the repository instructions. Glob was the only filesystem primitive that worked.
OBSERVED: read and grep return permission.rejected (read; external_directory). Glob shows only this agent's own progress.jsonl, running.json, execution.json, stderr.log, session.jsonl and opencode.json. No issue126 artifacts, no Stage2 code, no frozen Stage3 protocol, no CLAUDE.md section 19 text were reachable from this session.
EVIDENCE: tool errors from read/grep, glob listing of the ideation_3 workspace.
REASONING: the idea has to be built from the round brief, the measured round history and the scope contract in the prompt, not from fresh code inspection. I will therefore avoid claims about exact baseline file names or the exact #126 proxy implementation, and will specify the mechanism architecture-agnostically at the encoder/quantizer interface.
OPEN: no local verification of the baseline RQ-VAE encoder, codebook sizes, or the #126 hard score/proxy is possible here.

GOAL: choose a coupling position not already occupied by the rejected/probed list and not one of the three examples most likely taken by the sibling agents.
READ: the round prompt's rejected list (BRANCHCURV-SID, GEO-SHELL-RQ, GEOPFX-SID, GEO_REPAIR, GYRO-TARGET-RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ, SUCC-TAN-RQ, behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts, cocond-markov-poincare-ot, CURVCELL-SID, SUCCFAN-CURV-RQ, BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB, poincare-frechet-successor-codebook) and the three named exploration examples (behaviour-weighted curved assignment/Sinkhorn, behaviour hierarchy in a negatively curved latent/quantizer, behaviour-directed curved residual/transition optimisation).
OBSERVED: assignment, hierarchy, residual, codebook-Frechet update, curvature-per-branch, Lorentz cone and prefix scoring are already occupied. The pre-quantization latent geometry between the RQ-VAE encoder and the residual quantizer is not in that list. GYRO-TARGET-RQ occupies the target side, so the source/latent side is still free.
REASONING: place the coupling in the object that the Euclidean quantizer sees, not in the quantizer's assignment, not in the codebook update, and not in a prefix score. One Poincare exp/log superposition layer is cheap, differentiable, testable with a single run, and its behaviour-off and geometry-off switches are exact and non-degenerate.
OPEN: whether the baseline latent norms make the curvature materially active; the proposal handles this with a measured median-norm rescaling so the geometry is not inert.

FINAL STAGE: the complete answer is printed in the session reply as one idea block, GYROSUCC-SUPERPOSE; the progress tool caps a record at 4000 characters, so this record carries the decision and the reply carries the full block verbatim.
Mechanism: insert one curvature-anchored successor-superposition layer between the existing RQ-VAE encoder and the residual quantizer. E_i = Pi(s*f_theta(x_i)); u_i = sum_j p_ij log_{E_i}(sg(E_j)); h_i = exp_{E_i}(alpha_i*u_i); alpha_i = 1/(1+ln(1+d_i)+H_i); the unchanged RQ levels quantize h_i. Curvature is fixed at -1 (Poincare ball, Mobius addition, exp/log maps); s is the measured median-norm rescaling, K the measured 90th-percentile out-degree; neither is tuned.
Behaviour: directed consecutive training transitions only, row-normalised, damped by out-degree d_i and successor entropy H_i, built only from the Stage 2 training split.
Switches: behaviour off gives p=identity so u_i=0 and h_i=E_i; geometry off replaces exp/log by a linear blend; both on is the single trained arm. No ablation arm, no sweep, no seed repetition.
Cost: about 5M extra FLOP per step (B=1024, d=64, K about 24), 72000 steps, about 3.6e11 FLOP total; one extra encoder pass per epoch (24556 items) so Stage 2 wall clock +10 to +25 percent; cache about 6.3 MB.
Diagnostics recorded, never admission gates: geodesic displacement, level-1 co-location of training transitions, code usage entropy/perplexity/collisions, held-out-training prefix probe, and the frozen #126 hard Q_H recomputed read-only. Primary judgement: Stage 3 test_recall@10 above 0.065.
Distinctness: not assignment/Sinkhorn, not hierarchy in the quantizer, not a curved residual inside RQ, not codebook Frechet updates, not curvature-per-branch, not Lorentz cone, not a prefix-score optimisation; it changes the object the Euclidean quantizer sees and leaves the quantizer and codebook update untouched.
Open: whether curvature stays materially active under content reconstruction, whether oversmoothing/codebook collapse occurs, and whether level-1 co-location reaches recall.
